items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I know of him. I think Zutti Singleton too.

ctx.x: I know of him. I think Zutti Singleton too.
Zutti Lidas. Very likely. I was playing on the drums. Zutti soon after joined uh probably Carol Dickerson. Probably so. And uh. Yeah.
I. Carol Dickerson I forgot he's passed through. I was on the road with him for a while. Oh were you? With his orchestra.
